questions.solution: In reverse bias condition of photodiode, the change in saturation reverse current is directly proportional to the change in the incident light flux or light intensity, which can be measured accurately. It is not so when photodiode is forward bias.

When switch A is closed and switch B is open, the current will flow through the bulb and it will glow.

options: Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Both Statement I and Statement II are true
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
S-1 Statement 1 is false because in case of two discrete back to back connected diodes, there are four doped regions instead of three and there is nothing that resembles a thin base region between an emitter and a collector.
S-2 Statement-2 is true, as β=ICIB
